system.description:
You do not lose your [Stop] ability even if you are in [Staggered] or [Dazed] status. Your "Soldier Coerce" check gains +2. At the start of battle, you may also increase your [Hate] by +1. Shoulder guard adorned with a terrifying skull design. It is said that a demon is attached to it, and it sometimes lets out a sudden, cackling laugh. It has an excellent effect of drawing in surrounding enemies even when the user is unable to move, but after Catastrophe, the item became cursed, and the user is regarded as eerie, causing the number of users to decrease.

Skull's Crest[Core Material](80G)+Quilbiri(270G)+[Magic Catalyst 6](50G)×2+Crafting Cost(190G)
